scientific_context: Extends the recent strong asymptotic for the unrestricted two-generator prime-index lattice to every fixed full-rank finite-index exponent sublattice. The leading logarithmic coefficient depends only on the lattice index h through h^{-1/3}, while lower terms retain boundary arithmetic. A dependent three-generator collision family generated by r^q, s^q and rs follows as the congruence lattice A congruent to B modulo q.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result fixes the exponent lattice, r and s, assumes r and s multiplicatively independent, and does not claim uniformity for growing lattice index. It treats full-rank sublattices through the nonnegative quadrant rather than arbitrary affine cosets or lower-rank exponent sets. The 2017 Neyt slides use broad language about multiplicatively generated sets, but their displayed product transform counts exponent representations when generators are dependent and therefore does not establish the distinct-index collision corollary or the finite-index lattice theorem. Unindexed concurrent work around the September 2026 motivating preprint remains a residual originality risk. The finite verification is corroborative only. No independent validation, independent audit, or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
